Entra con SPID

SPID è il sistema di accesso che consente di utilizzare, con un'identità digitale unica, i servizi online della Pubblica Amministrazione e dei privati accreditati. Se sei già in possesso di un'identità digitale, accedi con le credenziali del tuo gestore. Se non hai ancora un'identità digitale, richiedila ad uno dei gestori.

Attenzione: in questa fase di avvio del sistema, le credenziali SPID sono utilizzabili solo per l'accesso ai servizi per i cittadini e i patronati.

normalized.description: PPMT REFERENCE: SATCEN/2026/OP/0005 | INTERNAL REFERENCE: SATCEN OP-05/26 | CONTRACT NOTICE: OJ S 173/2026 08/09/2026 | Description of the procurement: | The objective of this call for tenders is to award a service framework contract to a single economic operator for the production and supply of geospatial products for the Copernicus security service component on support to EU external and security actions (‘the Copernicus SESA Service’). | The Satcen, as the manager and coordinator of the Copernicus SESA service, seeks to acquire services to provide rapid and on-demand geospatial products based on the analysis of satellite imagery and collateral data for the detection and monitoring of events or activities that may have implications for the EU and global security. | Such products include, inter alia, layers, maps and databases under different formats. | Estimated total value: | The estimated total value of the contract is 6,090,000.00 EUR, excluding VAT. | Duration of the contract: | 18 months. | The framework contract is concluded for an initial period of 12 months, renewable 1 time for a period of 6 months. | Procurement documents: | The procurement documents are available for unrestricted and full direct access, free of charge, at: | https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/tender-details/6cfec140-8f2f-4ba7-9fe3-8b0ecc024f13-CN?#anchorDocuments | Type of procedure | Open Procedure | Business sector (CPV) | Main CPV code: 71354100 Digital mapping services | Key dates: | Launch date: | 04/09/2026 | Deadline for submitting questions: | 21/10/2026 | Deadline for receipt of tenders: | 29/10/2026 - 16:00 h CET | Opening of tenders: | 30/10/2026 - 12:00 h CET
